cohort: Newborns born between 28-36 weeks of gestation admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit, excluding those with maternal thyroid disease, severe intracranial problems, or congenital anomalies.
finding: Levothyroxine replacement therapy was associated with increased rates of BPD and ROP, but it did not appear to improve long-term neurological outcomes in infants with THOP.
gest_age: 28-36 weeks, with a mean of 34.4 +/- 3.8 weeks in the study group and 37.2 +/- 2.3 weeks in controls
